reason: The SoftBank Group Corp 2025 Annual Report does not disclose any specific Total Addressable Market (TAM) figures. The document focuses on the company's investment strategy, ASI (Artificial Super Intelligence) vision, and NAV (Net Asset Value) metrics. While CEO Masayoshi Son mentions that he expects at least 5% of global GDP (approximately ¥1,300 trillion or ~$8.7 trillion) to be generated by a few ASI core companies within 10 years, this is a personal prediction about the entire ASI industry, not a company-disclosed TAM for SoftBank Group's specific addressable market. No TAM figures are found in 10-K, 20-F, earnings materials, or investor presentations cited in this filing.
